title: Pullback stalk comparison commutes with changes of geometric lifts
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes, $\Omega$ a separably closed field, $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$, $t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$, and $s f=t$. For an abelian sheaf $M$ on $Y_{\mathrm{et}}$, there is an additive isomorphism $j:(f^*M)_s\cong M_t$ [lemma-openclosed-stalk-upperstar] with the following property. For every endomorphism $\tau$ of $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ with $\tau s=s$, and additive endomorphisms $a$ of $(f^*M)_s$ and $b$ of $M_t$, if both send every represented germ $(U,x,z)$ to $(U,\tau x,z)$, then $b\circ j=j\circ a$. No Galois representation or equivalence of categories is assumed.

source.place: Tag 03Q1, Lemma 59.36.2(3); Tag 03QW, equation 59.56.0.1 and Remark 59.56.6

proof.text: Substitute t = s followed by f and let k be the inverse component of the canonical comparison Etale.upperStarCompSheafFiberIso from lemma-openclosed-stalk-upperstar. On a germ (V,v,z), k is the germ at the base-changed lift (v,s) of the section obtained from z by the abstract pullback adjunction unit and the comparison from abstract to constructed pullback. Expand the comparison, use toPresheafFiber_sheafFiberIso_inv_app, toPresheafFiber_sheafFiberComapIso_hom_app, and naturality of toPresheafFiber for the comparison of sheaves to prove this formula.

For tau with tau followed by s = s, let v prime be tau followed by v and let x and x prime be the base-changed lifts of v and v prime. Their first projections show that x prime and tau followed by x agree on V; their second projections agree on X by the hypothesis on tau. The universal property of the pullback gives x prime = tau followed by x. The hypothesis hb identifies the germ at v followed by b with the germ at v prime. The hypothesis ha identifies the germ at x followed by a with the germ at x prime, for the same pulled-back section. Apply the germ formula on both sides to deduce k followed by a = b followed by k after precomposition with every germ map. The colimit hom-ext lemma proves equality of the stalk morphisms.
Choose j to be k inverse. Precompose k followed by a = b followed by k with k inverse, then cancel the isomorphism k on the right. This gives j followed by b = a followed by j.

theorem exists_etale_pullback_stalk_germ_action
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X) (t : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y) (hst : s ≫ f = t)
    (M : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    ∃ j : (pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.obj
        ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj M) ≅
      (pointSmallEtale t).sheafFiber.obj M,
    ∀ (τ : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of Ω)) (_hτs : τ ≫ s = s)
    (a : ((pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.obj
        ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj M)) ⟶
      ((pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.obj
        ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj M)))
    (b : (pointSmallEtale t).sheafFiber.obj M ⟶
      (pointSmallEtale t).sheafFiber.obj M)
    (ha : ∀ (U : X.Etale) (x x' : (pointSmallEtale s).fiber.obj U)
      (_hx : x'.left = τ ≫ x.left)
      (z : ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj M).obj.obj (op U)),
      a ((pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber U x
        ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj M).obj z) =
      (pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber U x'
        ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj M).obj z)
    (hb : ∀ (U : Y.Etale) (x x' : (pointSmallEtale t).fiber.obj U)
      (_hx : x'.left = τ ≫ x.left) (z : M.obj.obj (op U)),
      b ((pointSmallEtale t).toPresheafFiber U x M.obj z) =
      (pointSmallEtale t).toPresheafFiber U x' M.obj z),
    j.hom ≫ b = a ≫ j.hom
